content: Dr. Maged Younes, a specialist in public health, iron and vitamin A nutrition, and program research, is associated with the Committee on World Food Security at the Food and Agriculture Organization in Rome, Italy. His expertise spans food safety, public health, and program management. Dr. Robert J. Berry, from the Prevention Research Branch at the National Center on Birth Defects and Developmental Disabilities, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in Atlanta, United States, focuses on epidemiology, folate, and food fortification. Dr. Andreas Bluethner, affiliated with BASF SE in Limburgerhof, Germany, specializes in fortificants and food fortification. Dr. Julia Finkelstein, based at Cornell University in Ithaca, United States, is an expert in epidemiology and systematic reviews. Dr. Elvira González de Mejía, from the Department of Food Science and Human Nutrition at the University of Illinois in Urbana, United States, has expertise in fortification procedures and fortificants. Dr. Jeff Gwirtz, associated with the Food Fortification Initiative in Manhattan, United States, focuses on miller and grain fortification. Professor Richard Hurrell, from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, Institute of Food Science and Nutrition in Zürich, Switzerland, specializes in iron metabolism, bioavailability, and fortification. Dr. Chowdhury Jalal, from the Micronutrient Initiative in Ottawa, Canada, is an expert in systematic reviews, micronutrient stability, and monitoring and evaluation. Mr. Phillip J. Makhumula-Nkhoma, an independent consultant based in Lilongwe, Malawi, focuses on legislation and regulatory affairs. Dr. Luis A. Mejía, from the Department of Food Science and Human Nutrition at the University of Illinois in Urbana, United States, specializes in regulatory affairs. Dr. Regina Moench-Pfanner, affiliated with the Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition (GAIN) in Geneva, Switzerland, focuses on food fortification and nutrition programs. Dr. Helena Pachón, from the Food Fortification Initiative at Emory University in Atlanta, United States, is a nutrition scientist. Mr. Peter Ranum, an independent consultant based in Tucson, United States, specializes in industrial milling and fortification. Mr. Georg Steiger, from DSM Nutritional Products in Kaiseraugst, Switzerland, focuses on fortificants, micronutrients, and biochemistry. Dr. Parmi S. Suchdev, from the Department of Pediatrics and Global Health at Emory University in Atlanta, United States, specializes in pediatrics and global health. Dr. Nancy J. Aburto, a Nutrition Adviser with the United Nations World Food Programme in Rome, Italy, contributes expertise in nutrition. Mr. Ronald Afidra Olema, the Africa Network Coordinator for the Food Fortification Initiative in Kampala, Uganda, focuses on food fortification. Dr. Laillou Arnaud, a Nutrition Specialist with the United Nations Children’s Fund in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, has expertise in nutrition. Dr. Omar Dary, a Health Science Specialist (Nutrition) with the Bureau of Global Health at the U.S. Agency for International Development in Washington, D.C., United States, contributes expertise in global health and nutrition. Dr. Luis A. Mejía, from the Department of Food Science and Human Nutrition at the University of Illinois in Urbana, United States, is also associated with the College of Agricultural, Consumer, and Environmental Sciences. His expertise includes regulatory affairs and nutrition science.
